name: Memento Mori – Live Deliberately
summary: A personal-development membership with weekly SMS or email reminders, short courses, guided reflections and journals aimed at building consistency.
best_for: People who want gentle, regular reminders and structured reflection to beat procrastination

name: Moon-Stacked Personalized Moon Reading
summary: A personalized moon reading built from your birth details that describes your 'Moon Stack' and its themes for emotions, relationships and direction.
best_for: Astrology fans curious about their moon sign and emotional patterns

name: Stop Texting Like Roommates – Couples Texting Ebook
summary: An ebook for couples whose texts have become pure logistics, teaching a simple '3-Text Bridge' method to bring warmth back into daily messages.
best_for: Married or long-term couples who want small, practical ways to reconnect day to day

name: Unforgettable Brazilian Recipes – Trilingual Edition
summary: A digital cookbook of traditional Brazilian dishes, sweets and drinks written in Portuguese, English and Spanish with step-by-step instructions.
best_for: Home cooks and bilingual families who want authentic Brazilian recipes in more than one language
